description: Mobilfunkantennen in der Hanse- und Universitätsstadt Rostock is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geo.sv.rostock.de. This data set includes the locations of the mobile antennas in the Hanseatic and University City of Rostock with information on location certificate number, location description, operator, date of issue, distance of the antenna bottom edge to the ground in the unit meters, horizontal safety distance to the antenna in the unit meters, vertical safety ... Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Mobile antennas in the Hanseatic and University City of Rostock" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include inspireidentifiziert. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WFS. The listing shows 2024-01-17 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://www.opendefinition.org/licenses/cc-zero). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
